srs.desc:
Biscuit waist apron 2 x hip pocket.— Oliver Harvey Trims.  
Detachable stud fastened waist ties using the reverse side of the fabric
FOR THIS SPECIAL WAIST TIES ARE SELF FABRIC SO ARE CUT WITH THE APRON AND PACKED WITH THE APRON
srs.brandPlace: Orange flame logo 35.5mm H x 40.3mm W. Set to left front as worn. Centre of logo to be in line with front edge of left pocket as worn.

trims.desc: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BISCUIT 08569 — cost per metre
LARGE BRONZE STUD MALE PART — apron stud, pair with CMP-STD-SOC-9B-287
LARGE BRONZE POST FEMALE PART — apron stud, pair with CMP-STD-PST-9B-287
ANTIQUE BRASS EYELET 30MM — pair with CMP-30RD-28-931 ring
Oliver Harvey Side Seam Tax Tab Red/White (23x29mm) — every OH product, qty 1
OH GREASEPROOF TISSUE 500x750 — 1 sheet per OH product

srs.mfg:
Wash/care instructions 55% COTTON/45% POLYESTER - 70 DEGREE WASH/2 DOT IRON/P DRY CLEAN/ DO NOT BLEACH/TUMBLE DRY  SET LABEL 4CM DOWN FROM FINISHED RIGHT SIDE SEAM AS WORN
Set eyelet re-inforcement pieces.
DOUBLE TURN SIDE SEAM , TOP AND HEM AND TOPSTITCH 12MM.    INSERT LABELS RIGHT SIDE SEAM.
LABELOH5771 - SET OH LABEL 4CM DOWN FROM RIGHT SIDE SEAM AS WORN.  SET ON TOP OF CARE LABEL.
SET HEM TO POCKET.  DOUBLE TURN 1 + 2CM AND TOPSTITCH 1.8CM
EDGESTITCH POCKET TO FRONT.  POCKETS SET 16CM DOWN FROM  FINISHED TOP EDGE  AND SET 5CM IN FROM FINISHED SIDE SEAM.  INSERT RED OH TAB TO TOP OF LEFT SIDE OF LEFT  POCKET AS WORN.
Red Taxtab SET LEVEL WITH TOP OF LEFT POCKET. LEFT SIDE OF POCKET AS WORN.
MAKE WAIST TIES - Use reverse side of fabric as right side
V TACK (TRIANGLE STITCH) TOP OF POCKETS TO SECURE.
BAG OUT BOTH ENDS OF STRAP.  ENCLOSE RAW EDGES AND EDGESTITCH LONG EDGE.  PRESS TO ENSURE THERE IS NO TWISTING OF THE STRAP AND IT LIES FLAT
SET TO STRAP 2 CAP/SOCKET AND 2 STUD/POST AT EACH END. USE MARKER TOTAL 4 STUDS
srs.fin:
SET EYELETS.  CENTRE OF EYELET TO BE 3CM IN FROM SIDE SEAM AND 3CM DOWN FROM TOP EDGE.
For waist ties - 2 x Cap and  2 x Stud set to one end of strap.   USE MARKER FOR SPACING.  Note Stud as pairs and keep together.
Thread waist tie through eyelet and secure.
CHECK,TRIM, PRESS AND FOLD.
WRAP IN TISSUE. BAG STICKER SET TO BOTTOM RIGHT HAND CORNER.
